$comment: Written by npm run schemas from core/schema. Change the definition there, not this file.
title: A Grok Build session's summary
description: Grok Build's ~/.grok/sessions/<encoded cwd>/<session id>/summary.json, the session's index entry: its id and folder, title, model, times, the session it came from, and what kind of session it is. The file carries no version, so the newest schema reads it.

info.description: The session's id and the folder it works in

generated_title.description: The title Grok made, or yours after /rename

parent_session_id.description: The session it was forked or restored from, or a subagent's parent

session_kind.description: worktree, fork, headless (grok -p), subagent, subagent_fork…; none for an interactive session

hidden.description: Left out of Grok's own lists; a subagent's session is, unless this says

source_workspace_dir.description: Where a worktree session's work came from
